title: eval-harness: add per-prompt regression CI hooks and metrics integration
author: Avery Chen
description: Motivation: reduce silent prompt regressions by running per-prompt quality checks as part of CI and surface lightweight per-prompt metrics to our observability stack. This change adds a CI hook that runs the eval-harness against a selected prompt set subset on PRs touching model evaluation code, exposes per-prompt pass/fail and delta metrics to Prometheus, and wires the results into the existing eval gating job. Scope: 1) CI hook script and GH Actions workflow for conditional per-prompt runs; 2) lightweight Prometheus exporter to publish per-prompt metrics (counts, avg score, delta-from-baseline); 3) a regression gating step that fails PRs when thresholded prompt-level regressions are detected; 4) tests and docs. Checklist: - [x] Add CI workflow and hook script - [x] Add metrics exporter + config - [x] Integrate gating logic into eval CI job - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Docs and runbook updates - [x] Verified on release/edge with canary dataset Implementation notes: the CI hook (ci/hooks/per_prompt_eval_hook.py) uses the existing eval-harness runner to execute a configurable subset of prompts (via .evalrc config), computes per-prompt scores, diffs against stored baselines in eval-harness/benchmarks/baselines/, and emits metrics to localhost Prometheus pushgateway as a fallback for ephemeral CI. The gating logic is pluggable: it marks PR as failed when N prompts exceed relative-delta threshold or when absolute score drops below minimum. Metrics are exported with labels (prompt_id, model_version, pr_number, job) to allow dashboarding. To limit CI cost we sample prompts by priority and only run large prompt sets on release branches. Backwards compatibility: default behavior unchanged unless the repo has .evalrc opting in or the workflow triggers on paths specified. Related: ENG-8421 for gating thresholds, ENG-8477 for dashboarding and alerts, SUP-1198 incident that motivated per-prompt visibility. See docs at docs/eval/ci-integration.md for runbook and thresholds.
